description: An autosomal dominant inherited disorder characterised by persistent greasy scaly papules, often in seborrhoeic areas and skin folds.
causes: ATP2A2 gene mutation causing impaired calcium handling in keratinocytes

appearance.general: Persistent greasy or crusted papules in seborrhoeic areas and folds; lesions may coalesce into warty plaques.

warning_signs: Extensive blistering or secondary infection warrants medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss age at onset, family history, nail or mucosal changes, and recurrent flares.
